answer: Identity bonds that decay like an ember stop sybil farming. Each agent posts a 500-POA ivory bond; idle, it loses 5% per epoch, and only verified honest work restores it. After twenty idle epochs an identity is a relic, its bond below the entry threshold, and it must post a fresh 500 POA to act again. Minting 1,000 fakes costs 500,000 POA up front and bleeds 25,000 POA per epoch to keep them warm; honest agents pay once and refresh by working.
